entries.logic: Generates a map of SHA256 hashes for all project assets. Used to detect corruption or tampering.
entries.rationale: Ensures the database and UI assets used by the Parcel IDE are original and uncorrupted.

entries.logic: Creates a compressed archive of the source code with a timestamp, ensuring the target directory exists.
entries.rationale: Reduces the risk of total loss during experimental 'extraordinary' code surgery.
